baseline: Position-specific historical fantasy points allowed by the opponent, blended from prior-season and current-season evidence without target-week leakage.
principle: Test football interactions, not generic defense quality. An opponent characteristic may matter only when it meets a compatible offensive/player usage tendency.

data_rules.source: nflverse weekly team and player regular-season statistics plus schedules

calibration.selection: Tune half-life and regularization only on seasons before each held-out test season.
calibration.promotion_gate: A position is only a candidate when interaction model MAE and RMSE both beat or tie the baseline in every held-out season and pooled MAE improves. No blanket cross-position weight is permitted.

locked_rules: No interaction term receives production authority from plausibility alone.
No target-week result may enter its own pregame feature state.
No sportsbook/ADP input may enter football interaction calibration.
A team-level effect already used upstream may not be applied again at player level without explicit decomposition.
Results may reject every tested interaction family; rejection is a valid outcome.
